03 / HOW WE GET THEREROOM FOR EXPLORATION. A CLEAR WAY FORWARD.

A little method
to the magic.

✳
01 / 06
01

Discover

Start with the right questions.

We get clear on the people, purpose, and problem. Good ideas begin with listening.

Listen → Map → Define
02

Imagine

Make space for possibility.

References, unexpected connections, and a few brave what-ifs. We find a direction worth exploring.

Collect → Connect → Explore
03

Sketch

Think with our hands.

Fast sketches and simple prototypes turn a loose thought into something we can discuss.

Draw → Arrange → Try
04

Create

Give the idea its character.

Design, motion, and development come together. The big picture and small details get equal care.

Design → Move → Build
05

Refine

Make the good things better.

We review in context, test what matters, and bring fresh eyes to every important detail.

Test → Discuss → Refine
06

Deliver

Ready for what comes next.

A considered handover, organised files, and a clear system that is easy to keep using.

Organise → Guide → Launch
